###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave the PR with Yogesh-Shivaji365. He or laurynmm can swap in "maintainer review" once the initial pass is done.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! We're waiting for @Yogesh-Shivaji365 to finish the initial review, so please make sure all of his open comments are addressed, including the major one from 7/25, and ask him to take another look. Once he's happy with it, he'll move it on to maintainer review.
```
